tool_args.rationale: The acquired horizon-spanning observations resolve the key ambiguity left by the short pilot: output changes sign at long horizons. Fit all five parameters numerically using the recalled sink-gradient modulation and distinct fast/slow adaptation timescales.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Already acquired; its long-horizon rows reveal the positive short-horizon to negative long-horizon reversal and constrain the slow adaptation timescale.
The existing short and long horizon observations support the specified five-parameter law; no additional trajectory batch is needed.
Irrelevant to identifying or fitting the supported target law, and explicitly unnecessary.
A stationary periodic harmonic response does not explain the observed short-positive, long-negative dual-timescale reversal as directly as the noted sink-coupled adaptation law.
